description: We are a team of  students passionate about space, technology, AI, and creative problem-solving. We aim to build an engaging NASA Space Apps project combining software, data, visualization, and storytelling.
summary:
Humanity has left behind historic rovers, landers, and Apollo artifacts across the Moon and Mars—silent relics often forgotten by new generations. Astro Relic is an interactive, browser-based 3D educational adventure that brings these abandoned space missions back to life.

Designed especially for school-age students, players explore authentic procedural terrains of the Moon (Apollo 11, 12, 15, 17) and Mars (Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, InSight). Players physically drive the 3D Lunar Roving Vehicle, recover 28 historical relic stars, interact with talking robotic companions, and take quizzes to earn official mission patches. 

By combining real NASA imagery, scientific vacuum physics, bilingual storytelling (English & Bangla), and personalized spacesuit certificates, Astro Relic ensures our pioneering space heritage is never abandoned, but forever remembered and celebrated.
details:
How It Works & What It Does:

Astro Relic is a full-featured 3D web application running directly in standard web browsers on desktop and mobile devices without installation. Players traverse eight iconic exploration zones—four on the Moon (Apollo 11, Apollo 12 + Surveyor 3, Apollo 15, Apollo 17) and four on Mars (Ares Vallis, Gusev Crater, Meridiani Planum, Elysium Planitia).

Key features include:

- Real-time 3D exploration powered by Three.js with terrain collision and physics.

- Drivable Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle (LRV) on Apollo 15 and 17 featuring realistic seated astronaut animations, rooster-tail dust effects, dual tire tracks, and authentic structure-borne acoustic vibration simulation.

- 360° interactive rover turntables with inspectable NASA hardware annotations.

- 28 relic discovery stars linked to authentic NASA archival photography.

- Bilingual voice acting and localized scripts (English and Bangla) guided by Nova, an interactive AI mission specialist.

- Interactive Space Selfie Booth and downloadable NASA Explorer Certificates.

Intended Impact & Benefits:

Traditional history textbooks struggle to engage young minds with space exploration history. Astro Relic transforms passive facts into active, memorable gamified experiences. It fosters STEM curiosity among school-age children, preserves lunar and Martian heritage sites digitally, and makes space history accessible globally through bilingual narration.

Tools, Languages & Technologies Used:

- Frontend & Core: React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Start, Vite.

- 3D Engine: Three.js with GLTF Loader, custom procedural heightfield corridor shaders, and particle systems.

- Styling & UI: Tailwind CSS v4, Radix UI primitives, Lucide React icons.

- Audio Architecture: Web Audio API for synthetic vacuum motor acoustics, procedural ambient audio, and HTML5 Audio for bilingual voice tracks.

- Quality Assurance: Vitest automated unit testing suite.

Creativity & Design Considerations:

- "Abandoned, Never Forgotten": Instead of treating retired rovers as dead metal, we designed animated rover companions that share their historic final transmissions with emotional warmth.

- Scientific Accuracy: The Apollo lunar drive incorporates accurate lunar vacuum acoustics—explaining to kids why no sound travels through air on the Moon, but subtle vibrations travel through the rover frame.

- Zero-Learning Accessibility: Built-in touch joystick controls, automatic landscape adaptation on mobile, and Nova's contextual cues ensure zero friction for young learners.
